# zachy.cc

> Personal site for zoop — cool things for the web. Cloudflare glazer, WebGL enjoyer.
> Site: https://zachy.cc

## About

zoop builds weird, fast, interactive things for the web: encrypted tools, real-time apps, and small utilities. Most projects run on Cloudflare — Workers, D1, R2, KV, Durable Objects.

The site is a single page: a wordmark, a short bio, an expandable project list, and contact links. Vanilla JS, no framework. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages with a Functions backend; content is served from Cloudflare KV via `/api/config` and rendered client-side.

## Routes

- / (the whole site — bio, projects, contact)

There are no other pages. Unknown paths return a 404.

## Projects

- drop — encrypted, no-account file transfer. Upload, get a link, share; files self-destruct after download or expiry. Workers, D1, R2 — https://drop.zachy.cc (src: https://github.com/zoop-dev/drop)
- b3am — real-time end-to-end encrypted messenger. Workers, D1, WebSocket — https://b3am.zo0p.dev
- pulse — free, privacy-focused Garmin companion app for Android, fully local. Kotlin — https://fdroid.zachy.cc
- foyer — open-source gated website framework with a built-in CMS; runs a family of sites from one config. Node, Cloudflare — https://foyer.zo0p.dev
- my portfolio — https://portfolio.zo0p.dev
- sp33d — network speed tester — https://sp33d.zo0p.dev
- pr0xy — web proxy — https://pr0xy.zo0p.dev
- m0rph — https://m0rph.zo0p.dev
- shortl3y — url shortener — https://go.zo0p.dev
- backly — a little code backup tool. CLI, JavaScript — https://github.com/zoop-dev/backly
- pwa stuff — cool apps — https://pwa.zachy.cc
- cm — compression — https://cm.loop82.com

## Tech

- Frontend: vanilla JS, no framework
- Backend: Cloudflare Pages Functions, Workers KV (content), D1
- Link shortener: lnk.zachy.cc (D1-backed)
- Analytics: self-hosted, privacy-respecting — no cookies, no persistent identifiers
- Deploy: Cloudflare Pages
